Amazing Italian Food + Beautiful Vibes
Oct 2025 • Family
This place serves some amazing Italian food. We ordered different types of bruschetta, pizzas and pastas - each dish was spectacular. What made the food taste so good was the freshly made sauces that they were using for the pizza base and the pasta. As vegetarians we had enough options to choose from and we could customize also as per our tastes. Service during lunch was quick and the prices reasonable.

There was a nice vibe to the place. The decor at both the entrance as well as inside, though queer, made you smile and feel welcome. Will definitely repeat when I am in Da Nang next.
